adjudication.rationale: In the new sync branch, `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the raw `fetch` `Response` from `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, returns `response` directly). But `GoogleCalendarService` continues to treat the return value as a Gaxios-like object with `.data` (`packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`: `const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token;`). A `fetch` `Response` has no `.data`, so `token` becomes `undefined` and dereferencing `token.access_token` will throw at runtime, breaking token refresh when credential sync is enabled.
